_note: The fixed words of the site in each language: menu, footer, buttons and what screen readers hear (Tine, file 88). The English words are the ones the site had before; a French or Dutch word that is missing shows in English (src/_data/ui.js). Templates read them as ui[lang]. Menu labels are found by the address in site.json. siteName: the name top left and in the browser tab (the English one is site.name). euLogo: the EU emblem with 'Co-funded by the European Union' in that language, the official files of the European Commission (logo download centre, November 2026), all 147 px high. The English menu, Join button and EU text stay in site.json (nav, footerNav, joinLabel, disclaimer), so they are not repeated here.
